## Problem and resulting behaviour

Describe the concrete change and link the ECR task. For design-only work, state the design outcome rather than claiming implemented behaviour.

## Validation

Record what was actually checked and the result. Link evidence where useful. Explain any unexecuted checks or remaining limitation.

## Coordination

Identify affected module owners and any API, schema, configuration or documentation changes they need to know about. Record actual review evidence; do not prefill an approval.
